name: shortlark
description: Shortlark: AI clipping SaaS. Python (FastAPI) API, React web app and pre-rendered React landing page.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,landing -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w landing"
scripts.dev:api: uv --directory backend run uvicorn app.main:app --port 4000 --reload --reload-dir app
scripts.setup: uv --directory backend sync && npm install && npm run db:migrate
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w landing
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w landing
scripts.db:migrate: uv --directory backend run alembic upgrade head
